nodes.title: Optimize LambdaRank directly for top five
nodes.hypothesis: Setting LambdaRank truncation to 5 concentrates pairwise optimization on the evaluated nDCG@5 region, potentially improving the official ranking metric without changing features or labels.

nodes.title: Broaden LambdaRank truncation for GAUC balance
nodes.hypothesis: A truncation level of 10 should retain emphasis on top-five ranking while providing useful gradients for additional within-user positives, potentially improving GAUC without sacrificing nDCG@5.

nodes.title: Disable query lambda normalization
nodes.hypothesis: Without per-user lambda normalization, users with more validation impressions contribute proportionally more ranking gradients, better matching impression-weighted GAUC while retaining top-five truncation for nDCG@5.

nodes.title: Use XE_NDCG ranking objective
nodes.hypothesis: LightGBM's XE_NDCG objective provides a smoother listwise approximation to nDCG than LambdaRank, potentially improving top-five ordering while preserving user-group training.
